name: Forehand drives in a row
howToMeasure: Forehand cross-court at a steady pace. Best of three tries; count every ball you hit onto the table.

name: Backhand drives in a row
howToMeasure: Backhand cross-court at a steady pace. Best of three tries.

name: Backhand pushes in a row
howToMeasure: Backhand push rally; only count balls that stay low over the net. Best of three tries.

name: Loops against backspin on the table
howToMeasure: 10 backspin balls to your forehand, one at a time. Count the loops that land.

name: Serves in the target zone
howToMeasure: Alternate short and long serves at two targets. Count the serves that land in the right zone.

name: Two-point footwork in 60 seconds
howToMeasure: Forehand from the forehand corner and the middle, alternating, for 60 seconds. Count shots that land.

name: Alternating bounces on the bat
howToMeasure: Bounce the ball on your bat, switching faces every bounce. Best of three tries.
